headings.usage: H1, H2, modal titles, and the main brand logo. Gives a highly official, documentary, 'Old Money Tech' authority.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, settings, standard UI text. Extremely clean, legible at small sizes, balances the serif headings.

mono.usage: Document codes, status labels, file names (e.g., .docx, .pdf).

primary.description: Vivid Crimson for primary actions. Instills a sense of urgent, premium authority. (NO Teal/Blue). Breaks the standard SaaS look completely.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used on the sticky sidebar and header. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70 with a 1px inner border of white/10. NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: Ultra-thin 1px borders (border-white/10). No thick or muddy borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal outer shadows (they look muddy in dark mode). Use inner shadows/glows for active states (e.g., box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)).
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp and structured. Use rounded-sm (4px) for inputs/buttons, rounded-none for major layout panels to emphasize a brutalist, editorial structure.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense but breathable. Statistics cards span 1 column, recent history spans 3 columns. Generous padding inside cards (p-6 or p-8).
grids.forms: Strict 2-column or 1-column responsive grids. Labels must sit cleanly above inputs with tight spacing (gap-1.5).

layouts.sidebar: Fixed left navigation. Clean, icon-led with text, heavily muted until active. Active state uses Crimson text or left border.
layouts.generation_zone: Massive drag-and-drop zone using a 'Tracing Beam' or dashed subtle border effect. Staggered entrance for the loaded Excel data grid.
layouts.modals: Full-screen or massive drawer-style modals for document preview/edit. They should feel like shifting into a dedicated workspace, not a small popup box.
layouts.tables: Edge-to-edge within their containers. No outer card wrapping unless it's flush. Action menus pinned to the right.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must have a 200ms ease transition on color and border. Primary buttons scale down slightly on click (active:scale-95).
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (10px) on route change.
motion.excel_drop: The drag-and-drop zone should pulse with a subtle Crimson glow when a file is dragged over it.

components.button: Solid background for primary, 1px white/10 border for secondary. text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide. NO pill shapes, use sharp (rounded-sm) edges to maintain authority.
components.table: Dense. border-collapse. Row hover is a subtle bg-white/5. text-sm. Actions aligned to the right.
components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0C] border-white/10 focus:border-[#E11D48] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E11D48]. rounded-sm.
components.tabs: Underline style or clean pills. Not standard Vercel boxes. Very wide padding for touch targets and visual breathing room.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA guidelines. Muted text must still be readable against #050505.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E11D48] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#050505]).
accessibility.testing: All buttons, inputs, tabs, and major UI regions MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-excel-zone').

media.images: Use premium brutalist architectural imagery for the login screen or empty states. Image URL: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1565626424178-c699f6601afd?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NjY2NzV8MHwxfHNlYXJjaHwyfHxhcmNoaXRlY3R1cmFsJTIwaW50ZXJpb3IlMjBicnV0YWxpc20lMjBkYXJrfGVufDB8fHx8MTc4NjM3MDk2MXww&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=85
media.empty_states: Muted, desaturated imagery or clean typography with no illustration to maintain the luxury feel.

3d_libraries: Framer Motion for page transitions and micro-interactions. No heavy 3D WebGL needed for this internal admin tool, focus on immediate DOM performance for large document tables.

login_background.description: Grayscale concrete brutalist architecture for an imposing, premium login or empty state background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React + Tailwind + Shadcn.
Ensure the layout has a fixed left sidebar and a scrollable main area. Ensure the header uses a blurred background, NEVER fully transparent.
Override default Shadcn styles to be completely sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm max) and use the dark theme colors specified.
The document generation flow must allow Excel upload -> Parsing -> Table view -> Modals for row editing.
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is imported from Google Fonts for headings, and 'Manrope' for body.
Use lucide-react for all icons. Keep them small (w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5) and elegant.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all' anywhere. Use specific transitions.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications in a dark, minimalist style.
Create .js components, NOT .tsx (since the environment uses .js files).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar standard shadcn path.
